newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes firmer, near 1,780 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes firmer, near 1,780 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed near 1,780 per dollar, firmer from the morning's 1,870-1,900 and 1,950-1,980 at Friday's close, as dollar supply heavily topped demand on the interbank market, dealers said.
"The lev gained some 200 from Friday. The market was rather bearish on the dollar in anticipation of continuing lev rise," one dealer said.
The lev briefly tested new highs at 1,670-1,690 per dollar in early afternoon but fell back to 1,750-1,780 as some investors picked up some cheap dollars, dealers said.
